note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1958: nominations 20 May 1958; six contests, polled 5 June 1958. The outgoing member in Moyra Castle was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph nominations list. Returned unopposed.
